title: Mixed Event — The Tomorrow We Hope For — Episode9 Please Let It Comes True

meta.Episode: Episode9 — Please Let It Comes True
meta.Event Outline: When Haruka stops by the shrine along her usual running route, she sees the shrine maiden who was there for her in her time of need collapse. In order to repay her for her kindness, Haruka decides to help out at the shrine in her stead.

rows.Line: Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow... I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So am I. I'm guessing it has to do with having to stand the entire time outside of breaks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hate to break it to you both, but we still have a stream to do tomorrow. Try to hang in there, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You don't seem tired one bit, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I know...! What if we did our stream dressed as shrine maidens?! I bet everybody will love it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nice idea, but something doesn't seem right about borrowing these for that sort of purpose... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No way! You guys really are dressed as shrine maidens! Cute doesn't even begin to describe how you look!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's what you're gonna lead with?
Not, “Happy New Year”...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena! Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Asahina.
Let's make this year a good one.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Hinomori.
Ena told us that you'd all be here, but I still quite can't believe that you're here volunteering as shrine maidens.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, some things came up and we all decided to help out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I see. You must've been very busy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: S-S-So cold...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, are you alright?
It's been warmer than usual around this time, but it still gets pretty chilly after the sun goes down...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That reminds me. How does some amazake sound? That should warm you right up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds great!
We might just have to take you up on that♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright, here you are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...
Ahh, so warm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! Amazake from a real idol!
I can feel it coursing through my veins! It's like all five of my senses are on fire now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You sound like an old man after a night of drinking...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
This is just what we needed.
Thank you, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're all very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've warmed up, let's start hitting up everything we can here!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Such as...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For starters, Omikuji!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Aren't we usually supposed to make our wishes first?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aww, don't be like that!
We'll be fine as long as we keep believing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to feel about that, but I don't see a problem with checking out everything in whatever order you like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I agree...
There's no rule saying that we have to go in a certain order.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess that's true.
Plus, I got to see Airi. Let's get this over with so we can head over to a diner to relax.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, I can show you where the Omikuji booth is. Shall we?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yay! I got a “great blessing”♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why'd it give me a "curse"...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, I've never seen anyone get that before! Wanna trade?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't need your pity!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... Kanade, you got #99!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you...
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Can I try again?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Of course!
Is it for someone else?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes...
Well... For all the others...
se_event_prayer_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright...!
Here you are! #1!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What did you get, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A “minor blessing”. How about you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I got the same.
I think it's because we both drew the same number.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right.
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It says, “Work hard and your wish will be granted...”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...
By working hard...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's do our best this year, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, let's...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey!
Looks like there's no line for the shrine! We can make our wishes right now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Be right there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It's already well past dusk...
Our time as shrine maidens is about to come to a close.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Yoisaki's group may very well be the last we see making wishes tonight.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, everyone got their offerings ready? We can ring the bell once we throw them in...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'm ready...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here we go!
se_event_prayer_2022_006
se_event_prayer_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to draw in a way that I can be happy with this year... And...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I'll do something about Mizuki myself... I can't wish that away after saying that I'd wait...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm glad we're celebrating New Year's like this again...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Please make it so things stay like this...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I want to discover the “real me”...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to compose a song that can save everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I came to take a quick peek...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But they seem completely focused on their wishes.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'll make a wish too...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Please make all of their wishes come true...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I thought I saw something poke out of Yoisaki's pocket just now... Maybe I'm just seeing things...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Everything alright, Haruka?
Is something going on with Ena and her friends?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Uh... No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was just marveling at how seriously they're taking their wishes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I noticed that too.
What they're all wishing for must be very important to them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally understand! It's natural to take a little longer when wishing for something really big or important!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, let's...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't actually know what they're wishing for...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I hope all of their wishes come true for them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And... That's a wrap.
Thank you all for doing this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That just flew by us, huh?
Still, I thought it was a great experience!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. It was nice seeing how everyone smiled as we distributed amazake to them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It wasn't always easy, but it ended up being really fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Also, it was great seeing so many people stop by to make their wishes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. It sure was!
Oh, why don't we cap everything off by making our own wishes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's go!
I'm sure all our hard work will be rewarded! Somebody up there must've been watching us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I sure hope so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's ring the bell...
se_event_prayer_2022_006
se_event_prayer_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to be able to spread as much hope as we can to as many people as possible, together...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, I'm all set!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! Oh, while we're at it, we should go see what fortunes we get!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, I'd like to get a good luck charm as well. Are there any that can help make sure our streams go well?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no way a charm for streamers exists! We just gotta make our own luck when it comes to that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
For now, let's just focus on making our New Year's stream a good one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!!
